subject: Re: Next steps & PoC plan — deployment mode preference (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sara Li <sara.li@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps & PoC plan — deployment mode preference (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for taking the time earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery + the immediate next steps I promised:

Summary of what I heard:
- Primary goal: integrate LLM-based summarization into Acme Support workflow (reduce TTR, automate triage).
- Volume profile: ~50k inference requests/day initially, spiky during business hours.
- Data sensitivity: PII present in some support tickets; legal is leaning toward customer-managed keys.
- Performance target: p95 latency < 300ms for short prompts, sustained throughput of ~150 reqs/s during peak.

Deployment mode feedback you gave:
- Your engineering org prefers Dedicated capacity for predictable throughput and data isolation, but procurement wants to evaluate Hosted API first for speed.
- Security flagged Private VPC/on-prem as a future possibility if we need customer-managed KMS or air-gapped compliance.

Proposed PoC approach (high level):
1) Short Hosted API spike trial (2 weeks) to validate functional integration, end-to-end latency, and prompt templates. Success criteria: demo summarization accuracy >= 85% on our sample set, p95 latency < 350ms.
2) Parallel evaluation of Dedicated capacity pricing & baseline throughput ramp. If Dedicated meets latency and cost targets, move to 30-day Dedicated PoC with reserved pool and monitoring.
3) Private/VPC scoping (optional) — gather security requirements and timeline if procurement requests customer-managed keys.

Deliverables & timeline:
- PoC scope doc (attached): detailed success criteria, sample payloads, and roles.
- Hosted trial: target start 2026-07-20 for 2 weeks.
- Dedicated PoC (if approved): target start 2026-08-03, 30 days.

Next steps for this week:
- Sara: confirm which PoC you'd like to kick off first (Hosted trial vs straight to Dedicated).
- Tom/legal: confirm whether a data processing addendum (DPA) or KMS requirement will be needed for the Hosted trial.
- Marissa/Jordan (cc'd): prep Dedicated cost estimate and a short runbook for ramp.

Attachments: POC_scope_v1.pdf (high-level scope), security_requirements_acme.xlsx

Happy to jump on a quick 20-min follow-up tomorrow if helpful.

Thanks,
Ben
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | (415) 555-0142

From: Sara Li <sara.li@acme.com>

Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps & PoC plan — deployment mode preference (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the clear recap and the scope doc. Tom and I reviewed this with legal and infra this morning. A few quick notes:

1) We'd like to start with the Hosted API trial next week (2026-07-20) as you suggested — primary reason is speed to validation. Procurement wants to see initial numbers before committing to Dedicated.

2) Security: legal has asked whether we can enable customer-managed keys for the Hosted trial. If that's not possible for the short trial, they want a statement of what logs/metadata Redwood retains and for how long.

3) Success criteria (confirming/adding):
- Accuracy: >= 85% on our support triage test set.
- Latency: p95 < 350ms.
- Cost: baseline per-token cost estimate for the trial window.

4) Stakeholders:
- Sara Li (Product Lead, Acme) — PM owner
- Tom Reeves (Infra/Security) — security lead
- Meera Patel — Support Ops (will provide test dataset)

Can you confirm:
- what metrics will be tracked in the Redwood Console for the Hosted trial (latency, tokens, success rates, error rates)?
- point-of-contact for onboarding and any API keys?

If you can confirm those items today, we'll lock the trial start for 2026-07-20.

Best,
Sara
Product Lead — Acme Corp
sara.li@acme.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sara Li <sara.li@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps & PoC plan — deployment mode preference (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)

Hi Sara (and Tom) —

Great — thanks for confirming the Hosted trial start for 2026-07-20. Answers to your questions below:

Metrics we'll expose in Redwood Console for the Hosted trial:
- Latency (p50/p95/p99) per route and per model
- Tokens in/out per request and aggregate token spend
- Success/error rates (HTTP-level errors and model-side rejections)
- Per-prompt quality tracking: you can tag a subset of requests and feed back verdicts via our quick eval webhook to compute accuracy over your test set
- Cost breakdown: token usage, estimated spend by day and projection for trial period

Onboarding & POC contacts:
- API onboarding and keys: Jordan Blake (jordan_blake@redwood.com) will create trial keys and onboarding docs.
- CS/ops for runbook & monitoring: Marissa Cole (marissa_cole@redwood.com).

Security notes regarding customer-managed keys and logs:
- Hosted trial: we do not support customer-managed HSM-backed KMS on the short Hosted trial; however, we can provide a data handling statement and audit log extracts for the trial window. The security_requirements_acme.xlsx includes the fields legal asked for; please flag any missing items.
- If Acme needs KMS/HSM, we should scope Private VPC or Dedicated with KMS integration for the longer-term PoC.

Proposed immediate checklist (for 2026-07-20 start):
- Jordan to provision trial API keys and share onboarding doc (by 2026-07-16).
- Meera to share the support dataset (anonymized) and a small evaluation script we can run (by 2026-07-17).
- Tom/legal to confirm whether the data handling statement in the workbook is sufficient (by 2026-07-17).
- Kickoff sync: 20-min call on 2026-07-20 to walk through test plan and success criteria.

I updated the attached POC_scope_v1.pdf to reflect Hosted-first with Dedicated fallback. See the Google doc link in thread metadata for the live plan.

If that works, Jordan/Marissa — can you take the provisioning and runbook tasks? I'll follow up with the calendars.

Thanks,
Ben
